paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: The loss comparison between vanilla Transformer and the proposed SepLLM. SepLLM achieves lower loss different computation costs and different training time consistently.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the loss comparison between two models, Vanilla and SepLLM, across different computation costs measured in TFLOPs. The x-axis, labeled "TFLOPs", has a linear scale with values ranging from 0.00 to 1.25, marked at intervals of 0.25. The y-axis, labeled "Loss", also has a linear scale, with values from 2.40 to 2.75, marked at intervals of 0.05. The plot features two lines: the purple line represents the Vanilla model with triangle markers and a solid line style, and the red line represents the SepLLM model with circle markers and a solid line style. The purple line starts at approximately 2.74 and decreases to around 2.52, showing a steady decline with a slight flattening towards the end. The red line begins at about 2.73 and decreases to approximately 2.48, also showing a steady decline with a more consistent slope than the purple line.
